Audio and transcript test fixtures:
- Google FLEURS, English (United States) test split
- Google FLEURS, Bengali (India) test split
Dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
The two WAV samples are the first WAV members from the respective test audio archives. The accompanying TSV files contain the associated reference transcripts.
